narrative.structure: dual investigation — detective procedural / father's descent

analysis.themes: When two girls vanish, a father's certainty curdles into torture while a detective's procedure grinds slower than grief — the film asks what love justifies.
analysis.atmosphere: Grey, wet, and merciless; dread built from Thanksgiving-gray skies and the feeling that every door hides a worse room.
analysis.narrative: Two parallel hunts — Loki's methodical police work against Keller's spiraling vigilantism — converge on an answer that indicts certainty itself.
analysis.visual: Roger Deakins turns suburban Pennsylvania into a washed-out purgatory of rain, bare trees, and concrete.
analysis.characters: Keller's faith becomes his prison; Loki's tic-ridden patience is the film's moral counterweight.
